infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OcuLubak uploads survey videos to your office's server on the local network.

plugins.cameraPermission: OcuLubak uses the camera to record road survey video, which is uploaded to your office's road damage detection system.
plugins.microphonePermission: Survey videos are recorded without sound. iOS may still ask because the camera prepares an audio input before it is muted; allowing or refusing does not change the recording.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Your location is used while the camera screen is open, to check GPS accuracy before recording, and logged once a second while you record a road survey so each detection can be placed on the map.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: "Always" lets the GPS track keep logging if iOS moves the app to the background during a survey. Location is only used on the camera screen and while a survey is recording.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Location is only used on the camera screen and while a road survey is recording, so detections can be placed on the map.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: Lets you save a survey video to your Photos. The app only adds videos; it cannot see your library.
